whatTheRowsHaveInCommon: BATHROOMS DOMINATE, and that is consistent by construction rather than coincidence: §DOOR-RESCUE-REACH deliberately EXCLUDES wet rooms from its rescue pass (SPEC-CIRCULATION-GRAPH §9.5 — they are owned by the privacy passes), so a landlocked bathroom has no rescuer.

HOUSE IS AN ORDER OF MAGNITUDE WORSE THAN APARTMENT on the SAME engine and the SAME door router. The difference is one fewer refusal: `isHousePath = input.envelopeValidator !== undefined` is always true for a house storey, and the empty-result branch is guarded `if (viable.length === 0 && !isHousePath)`. A house storey must always produce a layout (SPEC-49 §3 item 2).
FOUR ROWS ARE A DOORLESS `Stair` — a storey whose VERTICAL CIRCULATION ELEMENT has no opening at all. SPEC-49 §1 CI-2 names this the most severe form. These should be the first four struck.

RESIDENTIAL HAS NO ROWS AT ALL, and that is an AFFIRMATIVE measurement over 34 shipped units, not an absence of data — 34/34 carried a CI-0 verdict. A blended 'the generators are ~20% broken' would have been true of nothing and would have pointed the fix at the wrong generator.
